name: ambientCG Evening Sky HDRI 049 A & B (CC0)
summary: Two new evening-sky HDRI environments from ambientCG, released 2026-11-13. Each ships as a ZIP with an EXR HDR, a tonemapped JPG, a ready Blender .blend, a USD (.usdc) file and a Godot .tres, in 1K up to 16K. Useful for sunset/dusk lighting and backgrounds in Blender, Godot, Unreal or any HDRI-based renderer.

access.notes: CC0: no attribution required, commercial use OK, no account needed. Variant B at https://ambientcg.com/a/EveningSkyHDRI049B.

procedure: Pick a resolution (1K, 2K, 4K, 8K, 12K or 16K) and click download; no account needed
Unzip and load the _HDR.exr as a world/environment texture, or open the bundled .blend / .tres / .usdc

stats.count: 2 HDRIs (049 A and 049 B), 6 resolutions each
stats.cadence: ambientCG publishes new CC0 assets regularly

verdict.why: Official publisher post, CC0 read on the ambientCG license page, pages and ZIP download verified (1K ZIP contents listed: EXR, JPG, blend, usdc, tres). High-quality, zero-friction HDRIs.
